# Atalk.TV

## English
Atalk.TV is an independent founder-owned global trends, media and knowledge project. It focuses on concise explanations, visible source trails, durable topic knowledge and machine-readable public information. It is not a KING AI ecosystem product.

Website: https://atalk.tv/
Public facts: README.md
Business direction: BUSINESS.md
Roadmap: ROADMAP.md

## 中文
Atalk.TV 是由创始人个人持有和运营的独立全球趋势媒体与知识项目，重点是简洁解释、清晰来源、长期主题知识以及机器可读公开信息。Atalk.TV 不属于 KING AI 主生态产品。

网站：https://atalk.tv/
公开事实：README.md
商业方向：BUSINESS.md
路线图：ROADMAP.md
